entries.0e931d439248ea06beb1526804e435763915471c: One resolved token model, reshaped into stylesheets, framework bindings, native code, and design-tool payloads.
entries.127a5bf3b67ff10cdc095abd9664a732a4481288: Every package reads the same resolved token IR. Change a token upstream and it flows to CSS, SCSS, native code, and Figma the same way.
entries.742680a232b7d884bd98c7e9d8bf6141ad440ee1: Run `pantoken generate` to emit Swift, Kotlin, Compose, Flutter, Rust, WordPress, and more. The same tokens, in each ecosystem's idiom.
entries.d663c2a3a159200ebca43ac9e1eab5eaa6123254: Install just @pantoken/css for a stylesheet, @pantoken/react for hooks and icons, or a bundler preset for Tailwind, Panda, or MUI.
entries.dc0022c48bbf821783348079101f1112acd00099: The tokens ship vendored as static JSON, so `npm i pantoken` never reaches for a GitHub-only source. Publishable, semver'd, offline-friendly.
